about: what each check of kit/checks.py gives for the `left` fight (EUPHONIUM against FLUTE, both real looks and parts): the verdicts, the printed lines and the numbers (tools/studio_export/checks.py's functions); the per-frame rows (the safe-zone boxes, the flash areas, the loop steps, the levels windows) are in the cache

band.how: on the 16-bit stem wavs (mono mix / 32768), each band-passed with butter(4, band, "band", fs=48000) as sections: section = dB of the fighter's stem minus dB of the bed (the bed buses added up) over each span; while_it_sounds = the same over the samples where the fighter's 20 ms moving RMS is above a tenth of its largest in the span. dB = 20 log10(rms + 1e-9). Passes when every while_it_sounds is above 0
printed: band: EUPHONIUM 150-1200 Hz over the bed (dB), section / while it sounds:  +6.1/ +6.1  +6.3/ +6.4  +6.1/ +6.1  +7.3/ +7.9  +9.4/ +9.4

flash.how: the stretch runs from 1 s before the first desperation move (or 8 s before the K.O. if that is earlier; never before FIGHT!) to 1.5 s after the K.O.: frames f0 .. f1 - 1. Each frame's relative luminance (reelkit.flashcheck.rel_lum, float32) goes to reelkit.flashcheck.analyse: area[j] is the largest share of the frame whose luminance changed by 0.1 or more against any of the 5 frames before frame f0 + j (darker state below 0.8); a transition needs a share of 0.25; two opposite transitions make a flash; passes when no 1 s holds more than 3
printed: flash: 35.4-45.9 s, 315 frames: general flashes 0, worst in any 1 s 0; largest share of frame changing >= 0.1: 17.1 % at 42.80 s  PASS

focus.how: for every frame: the ring's 8 corners, both balls (floor and top), each look's focus_points, the keys and the shards; coc_map(depth, focus depth, 26.0, 0.17); passes when the largest is 0
printed: focus: max subject CoC over 1830 frames: 0.000 px  PASS

levels.how: rows: reelkit.levels.profile on the mono mix of audio.wav (mean of the channels / 32768): the RMS in dBFS of each 2 s window and the rough hit rate. There are round(61.013 / 2) = 31 windows; the last one (60-62 s) holds only the 1.013 s that are left. ending = mean of the last 10 windows, opening = mean of the first 5, build = mean of windows 15.. minus mean of windows 0..14, spread = loudest minus quietest window with the one allowed dip left out

build (30-60 s vs 0-30 s): -1.0 dB   OK
spread (loudest - quietest 2 s window, the one allowed dip excluded): 6.1 dB   UNEVEN (target <= 5 dB)
dips (> 3 dB below the ending): 0   OK
printed: levels: opening (0-10 s): -12.4 dBFS (+1.9 dB vs ending), 2.3 hits/s   OK | build (30-60 s vs 0-30 s): -1.0 dB   OK | spread (loudest - quietest 2 s window, the one allowed dip excluded): 6.1 dB   UNEVEN (target <= 5 dB) | dips (> 3 dB below the ending): 0   OK

loop.how: picture: mad(a, b) = mean absolute RGB difference of two frames (int16 subtraction). steps = the mad of each frame to the next over the last 150 frames, then over the first 30; normal = max(median(steps), 0.5); seam = mad(last frame, frame 0); fails when seam / normal is above 2.5, when a one-off step is above 6x normal, or when a frame of the last 5 s (its final second left out) is nearer to frame 0 than half the seam and below 3.0 while the seam ratio is above 1.5. audio: the mono mix; dB of the last and first 20 ms (20 log10(rms + 1e-9)); a click when the jump from the last to the first sample is above max(0.08, 12 x the median sample step of the first second)
printed: loop check (the loop point must be the file boundary):
OK   seam: last frame -> frame 0 changes 0.69 vs normal step 1.29 (0.5x, limit 2.5x)
OK   restart: 8 recurring jumps in the last 5 s look like beat pulses, not a reset
OK   repeat: no copy of the opening inside the last 5 s
OK   audio level across the seam: last 20 ms -10.3 dBFS vs first 20 ms -7.8 (2.5 dB, limit 6)
OK   audio click: sample jump 0.003 at the seam (typical step 0.0203)

loudness.how: audio.wav / 32768 through the two BS.1770 K-weighting filters (48 kHz coefficients, in kit/checks.py), then -0.691 + 10 log10(sum over the channels of the mean square + 1e-12) over the samples of each span (first and one-past-last sample in `spans`). The kit prints the difference and returns it; it sets no pass mark
printed: loudness: intro (title card + count-in) -11.0 LUFS vs the fight -8.9: -2.0 LU

safezone.how: boxes: for each checked time t (frame int(round(t * 30)), Python rounding), every box reelkit.ui drew: [x0, y0, x1, y1, kind, info] in internal pixels, in drawing order. A box is outside when reelkit.config.safe_overshoot is above 0; panels and labels partly off the frame are skipped as sliding in or out, captions never are
